title: The Drowned Oath Revisited
author: Rosalind Montrose
blurb: Bram Vasquez, the youngest member of a dying guild, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
